features: The download race now proves each server's real quality before choosing — an HLS link's master playlist is checked for its true top resolution, so the winner is always a server that actually has your requested quality, and the log now says why it won
Download snackbars can be swiped left or right to dismiss — the View action still works, and dismissing one never cancels the download
fixes: Fixed the total size changing mid-download — the total is now computed once when the download starts (exact Content-Length for direct files, bandwidth x duration estimate for streams) and frozen for the whole job, so the ~488 MB figure never moves while progress climbs

Fixed Cancel sometimes doing nothing — Cancel now registers immediately in every phase (queued, resolving, downloading, remux, publish), disconnects a stuck download connection at once, and the job lands in Cancelled with the notification dismissed right away instead of finishing anyway

Fixed the race picking a server on luck — the winner is now always a proven exact-quality server (first proven arrival is the fastest proven server, so no resolve slowdown); a server that only has a lower quality is parked and served flagged as a downgrade only if nothing proves your quality, and the serving-server shortcut can no longer bypass that check

Fixed the Editor's Picks header overlapping its posters — the header now sits cleanly above the carousel with proper spacing, and the same fix was applied to the Explore header, which had the identical layout bug
